text.p: Following are the main stories in Monday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said the deferment of Cambodia's entry into ASEAN was unavoidable following recent developments in the Indo-Chinese country. He was speaking at a dialogue with Japanese public and private sector officials while on a visit to Okayama, Japan.
-- Uncertainty in Cambodia has caused indefinite postponement of the planned Trans-Asia Rail project linking Singapore to Kunming in China said Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik.
-- Berjaya Industrial Bhd is believed to be negotiating to buy two numbers-forecast operating companies, with one said to be a subsidiary of Repco Holdings Bhd.
